sloka: शक्यं यदि मया श्रोतुं न खल्वाज्ञापयामि वः ।यदि गुह्यं न चेद्वक्तुं श्रोतुमिच्छामि कथ्यताम् ।। ७.१.३९ ॥
transliteration: śakyaṁ yadi mayā śrotuṁ na khalvājñāpayāmi vaḥ ।yadi guhyaṁ na cedvaktuṁ śrotumicchāmi kathyatām ।। 7.1.39 ॥

translations.english: Rama asks how Ravana conquered Indra and obtained boons, and how this powerful son (Ravana) is not like his father (in terms of power or nature).
